_comment: Floorings (Floor tab). LIVE fields: swatch = flat PNG used as this item's coin-shop preview (shop-sold ids only). tex is informational: texture ids bind in assets.lua (A.FLOORPAINT), and the default_* entries are wired to the DEFAULT_FLOOR/DEFAULT_PAINT constants in room.lua. Add an entry AND its id to _order. colors = the rrggbb colours the workbench can give it besides its default one (each colour is stocked and placed as '<id>:<rrggbb>'). Display names are the skin's ITEM_<ID> strings (Locales/<code>/).
